lead: An anchor inherited from a handoff or a goal file drifts, and the line it lands on still reads like the right one.
body: This goal opened with `crates/nvs-host/src/isolate.rs:665` for a drain gate and `crates/nvs-codegen/src/emit.rs:3415` for a `THROWN` test; both had moved about 150 lines onto plausible neighbours — a cancellation branch and a switch terminator — so reading one confirms a claim it does not make. Re-derive an inherited anchor by symbol (`python tools/peek.py 'file.rs:re:<symbol>'`) before citing it or editing beside it, and write the number back into the handoff.
